propositions: Review bot discards per-call token usage from _usage despite computing input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens on every LLM call.
finalize.py reads _usage only for verify_requests count and ignores token fields; voter.py never reads _usage at all.

Bot must aggregate token counts across Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps and emit five CloudWatch metrics (input, output, cache_read, cache_write, total) with best-effort boto3 pattern matching existing error publishers.

Token metrics must be added to coverage.metrics dict in finalize.py and persisted in code_review artifact, then published to CloudWatch after successful vote in voter.py with fallback LLM_TOKEN_USAGE journald marker.
Pass-1 finder batch does not surface per-finder _usage and is deferred to a follow-up ticket to avoid threading usage through shared plan-review path.
